text.p: - Swiss president Jean-Pascal Delamuraz met with German Chancellor Helmut Kohl in Bonn to discuss Switzerland's position in Europe.
- The Swiss postal service, in cooperation with the Swiss Bank Corporation, intends to sell investment funds "over the counter" to customers starting in 1997.
- The number of people employed in Switzerland's service sector climbed by 18 percent over the past 10 years, whereas employment in the industrial sector fell by 10 percent.
- A total of 16,673 applications for building permits were submitted by the end of August, 1.6 percent fewer than in the same period of 1995.
- Union Bank of Switzerland announced it will change its credit policy in Switzerland and individually calculate credit costs for small and mid-sized businesses according to risk.
